newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan opposition takes another key Taleban town.
newsitem.headline: Afghan opposition takes another key Taleban town.

text.p: Opposition forces on Friday captured the strategic town of Golbahar in Afghanistan's Kapisa province from Taleban Islamic militia, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service said.

The Afghan Islamic Press (AIP) quoting its sources in Afghanistan said forces loyal to guerrilla commander Ahmad Shah Masood took the town after heavy fighting during which Taleban's provincial governor, Maulvi Khushal was also killed.
